title: Scarlet lip under a beauty dish

tokens.v: A tight beauty close-up against the red seamless: she draws the scarlet lipstick across her lower lip, eyes to camera, holding the case so its lacquer catches the light. She wears a sleek black high-neck top. The beauty dish itself is above and outside the frame; only its light shows, with a crisp shadow under her chin. 100mm, framed from brow to collarbone, skin with real texture.
